note: Zephyr-80 Mk2 nucleus residency (architecture 2.7.6). Every nucleus object links into the fixed region (system entries 1-2) or into one cold set; a cold set is a 16 KiB page pair linked at 6000h-9FFFh and mapped at entries 3-4 for the code that runs in it. tools/mapcheck.py mk2 --link rewrites every reference that enters a cold set from outside it (the fixed region, common or another set) to a fixed-region veneer that maps the set for the call (kernel/memory/mk2/cold_call.asm), places set n >= 1 at n * 10000h + 6000h in the link and refuses a data reference into a set from outside it. The objects under driver_api are the ones a resident driver's code reaches (the bootstrap table, the IRQ trampoline and their callees); they may not reference a cold set, because the driver domain occupies entries 3-6 while a driver runs. driver_call_remaps lists the system entries a driver_api service remaps during a driver's call and the stack it runs on meanwhile: the caller's, or a named nucleus stack. A driver's private stack (a symbol pair X_stack, X_stack_top in its image) may not lie in an entry a service remaps on the caller's stack, and every nucleus stack lies in entries that are never remapped. tools/mapcheck.py mk2 enforces the regions, the sets, the lists, the stacks and the common-page budget.
